sbar.situation: Recovery was not confirmed: the incident commander gave up before the bank system was shown to be healthy. Screening is running on its standby, and clearing has been restarted with item 92 set aside.
sbar.background: The facts given do not show what changed or when. The incident commander acted on two components, screening and clearing.
sbar.assessment: No root cause was confirmed. The incident commander itself failed screening over to its standby (done), quarantined clearing item 92 for the operations team (done), and restarted clearing (done), but none of these was shown to restore service.
sbar.recommendation: Check now whether screening on standby and the restarted clearing are processing correctly, and find the root cause before failing screening back. The operations team has been asked (soon priority) to review clearing item 92: repair and resubmit it, or close it with its customer, as its payment is held until then.
